entries.reason: The target M4 builds a two-geometry indexed/non-indexed triangle BLAS plus a procedural-AABB BLAS, refits triangle and AABB geometry from translated to centered coordinates, clones and compacts the triangle BLAS after a 616-byte compacted-size report for its 768-byte allocation, traverses the compact copy through a three-instance TLAS refit from an x=10 instance translation, returns a mask-isolated inline RayQuery hit against the multi-geometry BLAS, derives the executable pipeline from a collection and grows it with an inherited hit-group alias whose shader-table record supplies behavior-checked local-root constant/CBV/SRV/UAV data, executes renamed second miss/callable records from 64-byte-stride tables with local constants plus raygen/triangle-any-hit/closest-hit/procedural-intersection records with depth-2 recursion through DispatchRays; mixed triangle/AABB geometry, larger geometry/instance arrays, serialization/deserialization, collection export filtering/merging, new-library state-object growth, local descriptor tables/samplers, and broader record-count/stride/local-data shader-table matrices remain unproven.

AS/MS pipeline streams, stage-specific CBV/SRV/UAV plus texture/sampler resources, 32 mesh lanes, eight-byte payloads, two dispatch groups, and direct/indirect DispatchMesh pass runtime readback, but mixed state, statistics, render-target arrays, and broader shader coverage remain required before reporting tier 1.
No sampler feedback emulation or Metal-backed equivalent is proven.
No work graph program object, backing memory, node dispatch, or Metal execution model is implemented.
No D3D12 video command list, decoder, encoder, processor, or VideoToolbox bridge is implemented in the DXMT D3D12 path.
Protected sessions currently return E_NOTIMPL or no-op and do not provide protected-memory semantics.
Device-side DSR factory behavior is not implemented or required for the current Metal backend.

A DXIL library creates a Metal linked-function pipeline with raygen, miss, triangle any-hit/closest-hit, procedural intersection/closest-hit, and callable exports. Stable identifiers and a grown inherited hit-group alias execute through DispatchRays, including associated local-root constant/CBV/SRV reads and an exact UAV write from the shader record; one collection-derived pipeline executes, while export-filtered/multi-collection merging and new-library growth, local descriptor tables/samplers, and complete stack/record-count/stride local-data shader-table matrices remain gated.

A four-byte AS-to-MS payload, object-stage root CBV and raw-buffer SRV, and object-stage dispatch pass readback; broader payload sizes, texture/UAV resources, barriers, and amplification patterns remain gated.
Node shaders are part of the unimplemented work graphs execution model.
Stream output has no compute-emulation path; PSO creation and format support must not advertise it.
Metal sparse backing is not implemented or probed; reserved resources must fail instead of falling back to committed allocation.
